description: Component NAMES quarantined from price matching and gap audits (Ronde 2, V3 SS8). These rows are NOT materials: sub-analysis references (B.02.a.1, B.10.a, U.4.2.b.2, sambungan B.02.b.5, Pas. Batu P.01.d.1.a), work descriptions (plesteran, penulangan, pengecatan, cetakan RISHA, pemasangan kabel tray), services (Penetrant Test NDT, Sewa Lahan), formula variables of the hourly equipment-cost calculation (item 4.1.1.1: Umur Ekonomis, Kapasitas, Pelumas, Biaya Bengkel, ...), and unrecoverable fragments. Quarantine, don't delete: the rows stay in the canonical data (their item cost structure is intact) and stay PRICE_MISSING at runtime (the resolver does NOT read this file); they are excluded from the pipeline NAME_KEY fallback (buildNameKeyIndex) and from the gap-audit missing count (audit-runtime-r2.ts). Keys are normNameKey(name)|normalizeUnitForType(unit, 'material') — the same normalization the pipeline uses, so Q-14's unit m' matches as 'm'. Q-13 is deliberately ABSENT (coordinator override: R204/B.06.a.1 recovered to a real material name). R192 is deliberately ABSENT (its fragment was merged by the cleanup into the real material name 'Superplastizer M.24.b').
